description: This bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-E (%) performance across three different model sizes—LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B—for four distinct configurations labeled in the legend: “no SFT” (light blue with diagonal stripes), “+ SFT on D₀” (orange with horizontal stripes), “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” (light purple with diagonal stripes), and “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” (pink with diagonal stripes). The vertical axis represents the CoLeG-E (%) metric, scaled linearly from 0 to 50 with tick marks at intervals of 10. The horizontal axis lists the three model sizes in ascending order of parameters. For each model size, four bars are grouped side-by-side, corresponding to the four SFT configurations. The bars are sorted in descending order of height within each group, with the tallest bar (representing “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂”) consistently positioned on the right. The approximate values for the bars are as follows: for LLaMA-2-7B, the “no SFT” bar is at ~3%, “+ SFT on D₀” at ~20%, “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” at ~28%, and “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” at ~30%. For LLaMA-2-13B, the values are approximately ~9%, ~32%, ~36%, and ~38%. For LLaMA-2-70B, the values are approximately ~26%, ~44%, ~49%, and ~51%. All bars are solidly filled with their respective colors and patterns as defined in the legend, with no additional visual emphasis such as shading or bolding.
